metadata.description: A project template for working with Claude Code: an indexed knowledge base, decision records, session cost instrumentation, writing control, and tiered subagents.

plugins.name: knowledge-core
plugins.description: An indexed, queryable knowledge base over a project's own documents, plus decision records whose `proposed` state is the open-questions register.

plugins.name: session-economics
plugins.description: Measures where sessions burn tokens and wall-clock time, and installs the guards that stop them doing it again.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: The Answer-first output style, plus a tool that measures writing against a baseline instead of guessing at it.

plugins.name: agent-tiers
plugins.description: Paired thorough and cheap subagents with one output contract, plus the prompt-shaper skill.
